theme: Minnesota pileated woodpeckers and rhythmic drumming: a wedge-beaked chick develops a tall swept crest, stiff prop tail, powerful gripping toes and broad shock-bracing throat folds. Fighting anatomy remains a climbing bird with wings, not a boxer wearing feathers.
habitat: Mature hardwood trunks, oak savanna edges and standing deadwood.
